stemMd: A number is between 30 and 50, is divisible by 6, and leaves remainder 1 when divided by 5. What is it?
explanationMd: The multiples of six strictly between thirty and fifty are thirty-six, forty-two and forty-eight. Only thirty-six is one more than a multiple of five. It satisfies both conditions.

distractorRationale.c: Forty-two leaves remainder two on division by five.
distractorRationale.a: Thirty-one is not divisible by six.
distractorRationale.d: Forty-six is not divisible by six.
